papers.title: Shared Spectral Parameters Between EEG and Basal Ganglia LFP Distinguish Sleep-Specific Oscillations in Parkinson's Disease.
papers.summary: This study analyzed simultaneous EEG and subthalamic nucleus local field potentials (STN-LFP) during sleep in 19 Parkinson's disease patients undergoing deep brain stimulation. They found sleep-stage-dependent differences in aperiodic spectral slopes between STN-LFP and EEG, with STN-LFP aperiodic features alone classifying sleep stages above chance and outperforming EEG.

papers.title: SleepStageNet: A Lightweight and Explainable Deep Learning Architecture for Multi-Channel Sleep Staging.
papers.summary: The paper presents SleepStageNet, a compact deep learning model (1.075M parameters) combining convolutional, recurrent, and attention components for automatic sleep staging from five PSG channels. In an Indian acute stroke cohort, it achieved 73.91% accuracy (Cohen's kappa=0.634) with subject-independent cross-validation, and generalizing to ISRUC-SLEEP with kappa=0.614 without fine-tuning.

papers.title: Disentangling EEG Fingerprinting and Sleep Biomarkers Using Generalized Weighted Ordinal Patterns.
papers.summary: This study used generalized weighted ordinal patterns (GWOP) to represent sleep EEG from 31 healthy subjects. It showed that EEG fingerprinting and sleep-stage classification information are partially separated within the same feature space, with XGBoost classifiers achieving 75.8% accuracy in inter-subject sleep staging and 63.9% accuracy in subject identification, and high correlation of feature importance across validation schemes.

papers.title: MTGNet: A task-oriented and spectrally guided framework for EEG denoising.
papers.summary: The paper proposes MTGNet, a deep learning framework for EEG denoising that integrates task-oriented and spectral guidance. On EEGDenoiseNet, it reduced spectral root-mean-square error by over 18.9% for EMG, 31.5% for EOG, and 14.0% for hybrid artifacts, and improved fatigue classification accuracy by 6.20-6.69 percentage points on real-world data.

papers.title: Automated Multimodal Sleep Staging Using DWT-Based Wavelet Decomposition and Explainable Machine Learning with Signal Sculpting Topographies.
papers.summary: This paper presents an explainable machine learning framework for sleep staging using EEG, EOG, and EMG signals from 30 healthy subjects. Using 37 features including DWT coefficients, SVM-RBF achieved the best performance with 75.18% accuracy (macro F1=0.7322, kappa=0.6784), and SHAP analysis identified EMG RMS, gamma power, and permutation entropy as most discriminative.

papers.title: NTSM: Neurophysiology-Guided Tri-Stream Selective State Space Model for Real-Time Driver Fatigue Detection with EEG-EOG Signals.
papers.journal: IEEE journal of biomedical and health informatics
papers.summary: This paper proposes NTSM, a neurophysiology-guided tri-stream architecture using Mamba-based selective State Space Models for driver fatigue detection from EEG-EOG. It achieves linear complexity, a COR of 0.8738 on SEED-VIG, and 92.95% accuracy on cross-dataset validation, with an 8.19x inference acceleration over a Transformer baseline.

papers.title: An EEG-Based Evaluation of Antidepressant Effects of Ketamine Enantiomers and Metabolites in Monkeys.
papers.summary: This mini-review summarizes a study by Iwamura et al. that used EEG in a primate model to compare how ketamine enantiomers and metabolites affect brain activity, discussing implications for understanding ketamine-based antidepressant treatments.

papers.title: [Research on electrooculography artifact removal from electroencephalography signals based on frequency slice wavelet transform].
papers.journal: Sheng wu yi xue gong cheng xue za zhi = Journal of biomedical engineering = Shengwu yixue gongchengxue zazhi
papers.summary: The paper proposes an improved frequency slice wavelet transform (FSWT) method for removing electrooculography (EOG) artifacts from single-channel EEG signals, using adaptive local time-frequency masking. On a semi-simulated dataset, the method achieved higher signal-to-noise ratio improvement and theta-band energy retention compared to existing methods, and was validated on real-world data.

papers.title: Commercial Metallized Textiles for Dry EEG Electrodes: Structure, Textile-Level Durability, and Controlled Frontal Validation Against Ag/AgCl.
papers.summary: This study evaluated three industrial conductive textiles for dry EEG electrodes using standardized textile durability tests, phantom impedance, and human EEG recordings. The woven Ag/Cu/Sn fabric showed best resistance stability across laundering, and all configurations achieved high temporal agreement with Ag/AgCl electrodes, supporting their use in wearable EEG.

papers.title: LD-CNN19: A Deep Learning Model Integrating Logical Reasoning and Knowledge Expansion for Small-Sample Sleep Staging Tasks.
papers.journal: IEEE journal of biomedical and health informatics
papers.summary: The paper presents LD-CNN19, a neuro-symbolic framework that integrates logical reasoning and knowledge expansion to improve deep learning-based sleep staging with small samples. It improved macro F1-scores by up to 4.22% and reduced N1-stage F1 variability, offering traceable decision support.

papers.title: Neural correlates of location-response compatibility in an immersive virtual-reality Attention Network Test: a multiverse electroencephalography analysis
papers.summary: This study examines location-response compatibility in a VR Attention Network Test using EEG with a multiverse analysis. The N2pc-window posterior lateralisation showed consistent incompatibility effects across 192 preprocessing branches, while behavioural differences were not reliable.

papers.title: Evaluation of MPEG-4 AAC Audio Codec Using EEG and EMG Signals for Use with DICOM® Neurophysiology.
papers.summary: This study evaluated MPEG-4 AAC audio codec for compressing EEG and EMG signals, using PRD, PSD, and expert opinion. Results showed significant signal quality decline and gamma/beta band changes, indicating audio codecs are inadequate for neurophysiology compression.

papers.title: [Multi-view signal integration via manifold learning for sleep stage classification].
papers.journal: Sheng wu yi xue gong cheng xue za zhi = Journal of biomedical engineering = Shengwu yixue gongchengxue zazhi
papers.summary: This paper proposes a multi-view spatio-temporal convolutional network with manifold learning for sleep stage classification, integrating multimodal physiological signals via attention on Riemannian manifold. The method outperformed existing approaches on public datasets, with ablation studies confirming the effectiveness of manifold attention and multi-view features.

papers.title: Ketamine Across the Dose-State Continuum: EEG Signatures, Network Dynamics, and Implications for Brain-State Monitoring in Anesthesia and Critical Care.
papers.summary: This narrative review synthesizes EEG effects of ketamine across dose states, highlighting differences from GABAergic agents and implications for monitoring in anesthesia and critical care. It concludes that validated ketamine-specific EEG biomarkers are not yet available, and processed indices should be interpreted cautiously with attention to raw EEG and clinical context.

papers.title: qEEG and Functional Connectivity as a Translational Bridge Between Humans and Dogs in Epilepsy and Associated Disorders: From Spontaneous Model to Automatic Classification-An Integrative Review.
papers.summary: This integrative review of 75 studies examined quantitative EEG (qEEG) and functional connectivity as translational biomarkers between humans and dogs, focusing on epilepsy and associated disorders. It found that dogs reproduce human patterns of altered spectral power and coherence, supporting the dog as a natural model, but highlighted gaps such as lack of normative databases and heterogeneous protocols.

papers.title: XGBoost Classification of Epileptic EEG Using Nonlinear Dynamical Features and SHAP.
papers.summary: This study evaluated XGBoost classification of epileptic EEG using nonlinear dynamical features and SHAP interpretability on the Bonn dataset, achieving 93.3% overall accuracy. It found that analysis window duration (5, 10, 20 s) performed similarly, but the 1 s condition had lower descriptive performance.

papers.title: The Relationship Between the Functional Integration and Topological Complexity of Human Electroencephalographic (EEG) Signals: Three Moderating Factors.
papers.summary: This study investigated the relationship between functional integration and topological complexity in scalp-level EEG, finding an inverse relationship due to volume conduction, contrasting with the inverted-U relationship at source level. Simulations and empirical resting-state EEG showed that regularity and modularity moderate this relationship.

papers.title: The functional significance of EEG phase synchronization networks during information integration of left and right visual fields
papers.summary: This preprint investigates EEG phase synchronization networks during visual hemifield integration using a data-driven network analysis. It identified broadband synchronization networks under high integration demands, with associations to behavioral performance.

papers.title: Evaluating Validation Strategies in Motor Imagery EEG: A Full-Cohort GAF-PLV Analysis and Matched Sensitivity Study.
papers.summary: This study evaluated validation strategies for motor imagery EEG, showing that random cross-validation overestimates performance compared to leave-one-subject-out, which generalizes to unseen subjects. A GAF-PLV classifier achieved 58.07% accuracy under LOSO, and model rankings varied across validation protocols.

papers.title: Alzheimer's Disease Detection Using Combined EEG Source Connectivity and Microstate Features.
papers.summary: This study proposed the SMMS framework combining EEG source-localized connectivity (wPLI) and microstate features for Alzheimer's disease detection. Evaluated on two datasets, it achieved high classification performance distinguishing AD from FTD and healthy controls.

papers.title: [A method for predicting neurological outcomes after cardiac arrest based on time-frequency domain feature fusion].
papers.journal: Sheng wu yi xue gong cheng xue za zhi = Journal of biomedical engineering = Shengwu yixue gongchengxue zazhi
papers.summary: The paper proposes a lightweight deep learning model, WaveConv-SR-RepVGG, for predicting neurological outcomes after cardiac arrest using EEG time-frequency feature fusion. It achieves an accuracy of 81.7% with 18 channels and 81.2% with 4 channels on the PhysioNet 2023 dataset, outperforming mainstream deep learning algorithms.

papers.title: Quantitative EEG of frontal and central cortices during calm memory retrieval in schizophrenia.
papers.summary: This study investigates theta-band QEEG activity in schizophrenia during calm, resting, and memory task conditions. It finds that theta relative power is highest during calm conditions and decreases during memory tasks, suggesting a link between frontal/central theta activity and internal focus versus executive demand.

papers.title: A Learnable Entropy-Power Scaling Transform with a Radial Basis Function Network for Electroencephalography-Based Familiar and Unfamiliar Face Classification.
papers.summary: The paper introduces LEPST-RBFNet, a model combining a Learnable Entropy-Power Scaling Transform and a radial basis function network for EEG-based familiar and unfamiliar face classification. It achieves an average classification accuracy of 73.60% using a five-fold leave-one-block-out validation protocol.

papers.title: [A study on the propagation characteristics of epileptic spike signals based on simultaneous intracranial and scalp electroencephalography].
papers.journal: Sheng wu yi xue gong cheng xue za zhi = Journal of biomedical engineering = Shengwu yixue gongchengxue zazhi
papers.summary: The paper examines how epileptic spikes propagate from intracranial to scalp EEG using simultaneous recordings. It finds that scalp detection rate increases with larger activation area and decreases with greater horizontal distance, and that spikes from epileptogenic and non-epileptogenic regions show no significant difference in scalp detection.

papers.title: Feasibility of Gamified EEG Neurofeedback Combined with Adaptive Working-Memory Training in Older Adults: A Pilot Study.
papers.summary: This pilot study assessed the feasibility of a gamified EEG neurofeedback intervention combined with adaptive working-memory training in 20 older adults over 24 sessions, finding 100% adherence, no adverse events, and increased left-frontal alpha and frontal theta power. Despite small improvements on behavioral measures, the authors emphasize that effects are exploratory and require sham-controlled trials.

papers.title: AffectRoute: Role-Structured EEG and Peripheral Physiology for Subject-Independent Affect Regression
papers.summary: The paper presents AffectRoute, a protocol-conditioned model for subject-independent affect regression from EEG and peripheral physiological signals, using structured residual inference. Evaluated on DEAP and DREAMER, it shows consistent improvements over baseline and alternative fusion methods, demonstrating the effectiveness of structured residual inference.

papers.title: EEG-fNIRS self-supervised emotion recognition method based on dual-stream Siamese network.
papers.summary: The authors propose a dual-stream Siamese self-supervised emotion recognition method (DSSER) using EEG and fNIRS signals, achieving 98.03% accuracy in intra-subject emotion recognition on a ternary dataset from 16 participants. The method aligns modality representations via co-training and uses a Dynamic Gated Cross-Attention Fusion module for feature integration.

papers.title: Toward a Predictive Coding Account of Hypnotic Hypoalgesia: Integrating EEG Oscillations and Somatosensory Evoked Responses.
papers.summary: This review synthesizes EEG oscillatory and somatosensory evoked potential (SERP) findings in hypnotic hypoalgesia, concluding that hypnotic suggestions modulate late evaluative components (P200/P300) rather than early sensory components, with changes across theta, alpha, beta, and gamma bands. The authors interpret these effects using predictive coding and active inference frameworks.

papers.title: Repeated Continuous Theta-Burst Stimulation Modulates Resting-State EEG Microstate Dynamics in Athletes with Chronic Insomnia.
papers.summary: In a randomized sham-controlled trial, 7 days of right dorsolateral prefrontal cTBS in 35 male athletes with chronic insomnia improved sleep quality (PSQI), countermovement jump height, 50 m sprint, and agility compared to sham. Active stimulation also induced changes in resting-state EEG microstate dynamics, including increased microstate C duration and reduced microstate A occurrence.

papers.title: Linking Brain, Heart, and Behavior in Children: Frontal Electroencephalogram Activity, Respiratory Sinus Arrhythmia, and Internalizing Behaviors.
papers.summary: This study examined interactions between changes in frontal EEG alpha activity (FAA) and respiratory sinus arrhythmia (RSA) during stress in 152 children, finding that increases in FAA predicted more internalizing behaviors only when RSA decreased. When RSA increased, greater FAA was associated with fewer internalizing behaviors, suggesting joint central-peripheral nervous system influences on stress regulation.

papers.title: Psychobiological Correlates of Instructed Deceptive Responding: An Exploratory EEG Study.
papers.summary: In an exploratory EEG study of 86 adults, instructed deceptive responding was associated with increased frontal theta power, particularly in the right hemisphere, and trait anxiety positively correlated with self-reported deceptive behavior, suggesting involvement of executive control and conflict monitoring mechanisms.

papers.title: EEG-Based Neurophysiological Assessment of Pharmacopoeial-Quality Essential Oils and Development of Stable Micro-Emulsion Systems for Aromatherapy Applications.
papers.summary: This study evaluated EEG responses to inhaled essential oils in 28 volunteers, finding exploratory alpha-1 band changes that did not survive correction, and developed stable microemulsion formulations with low cytotoxicity, suggesting potential for aromatherapy prototypes.

papers.title: Association Between Glucocorticoid Exposure and Objective Sleep Architecture in Rheumatoid Arthritis: An Exploratory Pilot EEG Study.
papers.summary: This exploratory pilot EEG study of 20 rheumatoid arthritis patients found that glucocorticoid users had longer wake after sleep onset, shorter NREM stage N3 duration, and lower delta power compared to non-users, despite comparable disease activity, suggesting glucocorticoid exposure is associated with poorer sleep continuity and reduced deep sleep.

papers.title: A CNN Feature Extraction and BKA-Optimized LSSVM Classification Method for Small-Sample Rolling Bearing Fault Diagnosis.
papers.summary: This study proposed a fault diagnosis method combining Continuous Wavelet Transform, Convolutional Neural Network, Black-winged Kite Algorithm, and Least Squares Support Vector Machine, demonstrating superior performance over CNN, CNN-SVM, and CNN-BiGRU on small-sample rolling bearing fault datasets.

papers.title: Linking Embodiment, Simulator Sickness, and EEG Activity During XR-BCI Use: A Single-Participant Case Study.
papers.summary: This single-participant case study with a chronic spinal cord injury patient across 17 XR-BCI sessions found that embodiment positively correlated with frontal theta activity, while simulator sickness negatively correlated with sensorimotor beta activity. Regression and sensitivity analyses confirmed simulator sickness as the only variable independently associated with sensorimotor beta activity.

papers.title: Effects of a Dual Task of Exercise and Inhibitory Training on Cognitive Control Toward Food Cues and Frontal EEG Activity.
papers.summary: This randomized single-blind study tested the acute effects of combining moderate-intensity cycling with a food-related Go/No-Go task on inhibitory control, appetite, and frontal EEG in healthy adults. No significant group-by-time interactions were found for primary outcomes; subjective appetite decreased in the experimental group but the effect did not survive correction for multiple comparisons.

papers.title: An EEG-Guided Olfactory Interface: Prototype Design and Person-Specific Emotion-Decoding Validation.
papers.summary: This study describes a prototype EEG-guided olfactory interface and validates the EEG emotion decoding module, achieving 45.1% six-class within-participant accuracy from 40 sessions, but performance was insufficient for a clinically usable closed-loop system.

papers.title: The Influence of Shared Attention and Friendship on Emotional Processing: A Behavioral and EEG Hyperscanning Study.
papers.summary: This EEG hyperscanning study with 39 dyads (friends vs. strangers) found that shared attention increased beta and theta inter-brain synchrony in the prefrontal cortex for friends but decreased it for strangers, and altered emotional processing toward positivity. Alpha synchrony decreased with shared attention when viewing consistent images.

papers.title: Neurophysiological and Behavioral Responses to Gambling Cues in Individuals with Internet Gambling Disorder: A VR-EEG-GSR Study.
papers.summary: This VR-EEG-GSR study compared 28 adults with Internet Gambling Disorder (IGD) to 29 healthy controls during a VR casino task. The IGD group showed larger P300 amplitudes to wins, enhanced late positive potential (LPP) to near-misses, higher skin conductance responses to near-misses, and greater craving, indicating altered cue reactivity.

papers.title: Magnetoencephalography (MEG) Augments Semiology in Stereotactic Electroencephalography (SEEG) Evaluations.
papers.summary: This review discusses the complementary role of magnetoencephalography (MEG) in developing stereo-electroencephalography (SEEG) implantation strategies for epilepsy presurgical evaluation, illustrated with two representative cases. It also covers epilepsy surgical outcomes from evaluations incorporating MEG.

topic.label: EEG & Signal Methods
topic.description: EEG signal processing, sleep staging, neural time series, modeling, and practical analysis methods.
